decisions.reason: The maintenance oil line anchors the surface-treatment and care offer for oiled floors, needs few resources, and shows no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search.

Care products for oiled floors complement parquet sales and customer relationships, and the earlier withdrawal of the cleaning soap suggests the care range was already trimmed to its better performers.
A moisture-protection underlay is an expected system accessory for installers and carries no visible underperformance signal.
The high-density foam may overlap with the other underlay, but in a growing industry with slack, keeping it is the satisficing choice until a clear shortfall appears.
The oak parquet line is core to the firm's business and growing market, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
